name: IPTrust Brand API Schema
description: Every public IPTrust brand field is callable through JSON APIs and versioned through Git-backed history endpoints.

brandFields.slug: Stable IP ID / asset key used by URLs and agent calls.
brandFields.assetKey: Human-readable alias for slug in asset and agent contexts.
brandFields.name: Configured public/English name.
brandFields.mainLanguage: Main display language: zh or en.
brandFields.mainLocale: Public label for mainLanguage: CN or EN.
brandFields.officialWebsite: Official website URL, blank when unknown.
brandFields.display: Bilingual display names and secondary labels.
brandFields.profile: Callable business profile fields: officialWebsite, mainLanguage, intro, business, notes, classification.
brandFields.intro: Live bilingual intro generated from config or primary guideline.
brandFields.notes: Bilingual notes for public context, agent hints, or operational remarks.
brandFields.classification: Bilingual category arrays: tracks, audiences, and tags.
brandFields.theme: Brand colors, surface, ink, line, mode, and keywords.
brandFields.images: Image asset metadata and public site paths.
brandFields.logoUrl: Canonical public URL path for the preferred IP logo, blank when no verified logo asset exists.
brandFields.assetKit: Unified callable IP asset endpoints, colors, images, and moodboard source.
brandFields.moodboard: Derived colors, keywords, and image assets for visual direction.
brandFields.editablePaths: Source files editable from admin flow.
brandFields.source: GitHub source folder and local folder.

versioning.model: Git-backed history. Source edits flow through repository commits, then build into website JSON.
